content.text: No arbitration clause exists, and the governing law and venue match our preferred position.

input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects New York law and Section 28.2 gives exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County, which is precisely our preferred position. No arbitration provision appears anywhere in the document (search for "arbitration" returned no results), so there is no foreign seat concern. The pre-filing escalation in 28.3 is mutual and expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-preserving filings, and 28.2 preserves each Party's ability to seek temporary injunctive relief elsewhere to protect confidential information or IP. No redline needed.
